title: Juniper and the Rivergate
author: Emrys Eriksen
blurb: Astrid Oyelaran, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
